hebrewText: הִתְמַהְמְה֣וּ וּ/תְמָ֔הוּ הִשְׁתַּֽעַשְׁע֖וּ וָ/שֹׁ֑עוּ שָֽׁכְר֣וּ וְ/לֹא יַ֔יִן נָע֖וּ וְ/לֹ֥א שֵׁכָֽר

tokens.bdb: properly, to question or hesitate, i.e. (by implication) to be reluctant

tokens.kjv: be amazed, be astonished, marvel(-lously), wonder.

tokens.bdb: (in a good acceptation) to look upon (with complacency), i.e. fondle, please or amuse (self); (in a bad one) to look about (in dismay), i.e. stare
tokens.kjv: cry (out) (by confusion with H7768 (שָׁוַע)), dandle, delight (self), play, shut.

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.
tokens.explanation: lo — negação absoluta em hebraico: não, nunca, jamais
